panels.title: Переходы между успехом и сбоем
panels.description: Один итог на прогон для каждого historyId. Сбой — failed или broken. skipped и unknown исключены.

targets.rawSql:
WITH comparable AS (
    SELECT history_id, name, status, created_at, import_id, status = 'passed' AS passed
    FROM public.dashboard_final_results
    WHERE project = ANY(ARRAY[${project:sqlstring}]::text[])
      AND $__timeFilter(created_at)
      AND history_id IS NOT NULL
      AND status IN ('passed', 'failed', 'broken')
), ordered AS (
    SELECT *, lag(passed) OVER (
        PARTITION BY history_id ORDER BY created_at, import_id
    ) AS previous_passed
    FROM comparable
), unstable AS (
    SELECT (array_agg(name ORDER BY created_at DESC, import_id DESC))[1] AS "Тест",
           count(*) AS "Прогоны",
           count(*) FILTER (WHERE passed) AS "Успехи",
           count(*) FILTER (WHERE NOT passed) AS "Сбои",
           (array_agg(status ORDER BY created_at DESC, import_id DESC))[1] AS "Последний статус",
           count(*) FILTER (WHERE passed <> previous_passed) AS "Переходы"
    FROM ordered
    GROUP BY history_id
    HAVING bool_or(passed) AND bool_or(NOT passed)
)
SELECT * FROM unstable
UNION ALL
SELECT CASE
           WHEN EXISTS (
               SELECT 1
               FROM comparable
               GROUP BY history_id
               HAVING count(DISTINCT import_id) >= 2
           )
               THEN 'За выбранный период нестабильные тесты не найдены'
           ELSE 'Для сравнения нужны повторные прогоны'
       END, NULL, NULL, NULL, NULL, NULL
WHERE NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM unstable)
ORDER BY "Переходы" DESC NULLS LAST, "Прогоны" DESC NULLS LAST, "Тест"
